text_block_list.text:
I've joined Мэйсё Дото, a timid, clumsy

Umamusume, to take on the Twinkle
Series.

Her goal is to shine with confidence, just
like her
peer, Т.М. Опера О.

While she enjoys the support of her
friend,
Matikanefukukitaru, she's
criticized by her
roommate, Air Shakur,
for lacking sufficient stats.

Regardless, her refusal to give up is her
biggest
strength. Holding onto hope,
Мэйсё Дото begins
her racing journey.
